title: Global e-waste generated by year

source.name: Global E-waste Monitor 2024
source.publisher: United Nations Institute for Training and Research (UNITAR) / International Telecommunication Union (ITU)

notes: 62 million tonnes of e-waste were generated worldwide in 2022, an 82% increase from 2010, and projected to reach 82 million tonnes by 2030. Earlier-year figures are approximate, drawn from prior Global E-waste Monitor editions.
